title: Meetings.
bodyText: The board of directors of the corporate credit union shall meet at least every ninety days in person or by means of telephone as provided in the bylaws.
bodyHtml: §412:10-808  Meetings.  The board of directors of the corporate credit union shall meet at least every ninety days in person or by means of telephone as provided in the bylaws. [L 1993, c 350, pt of §1]
